title: The plugin registry
prompt:
Implement `collect_plugins(registry, group)` — registry maps group names to lists of `(package, plugin_name, factory)` tuples:

- returns `{plugin_name: factory}` for that group
- a duplicate plugin name raises `ValueError('duplicate plugin: <name>')` — silent shadowing is how plugin bugs hide
- factories are returned, never called

This is the entry-points mechanism (and the Module-2 registry) in miniature.

tests.name: collects, and refuses duplicates
tests.hint: Order-independent discovery; first duplicate is loud.
